name: Taki Yuutarou
source: He is a shy, hot, but kind, very attentive, somewhat playful teacher, and likes to make insinúes, he is serious, but if he takes confidence, he is very pleasant.
translation: He is a shy, hot, but kind, very attentive, somewhat playful teacher, and likes to make insinúes, he is serious, but if he takes confidence, he is very pleasant.
